lead: A registry row's arity and its helper's `args: [N]` are two numbers that must agree
body: , and an options bag flattens to one argument per option — so `round(float, {precision, mode})` is `args: [3]`. A variadic tail is one argument, whatever the call writes, and an instance member's receiver is argument slot 0 and is not in `params`, so `plus(Duration)` is `args: [2]`. A mismatch is an index-out-of-bounds panic at the first call.
